oracle: h3.latlng_to_cell on the float64 value of the float32 input; margins are great-circle distances (radians) to the cell boundary arcs of h3.cell_to_boundary

tolerances.derivation: GPU float32 mismatches measured at most 9.9e-8 rad from an edge (about 6 ulps of an angle near 1); twice that: points farther than marginBound from an edge must match exactly, nearer points may get a grid_disk(cell, 1) neighbor

edgePolicy.policy: a non-finite longitude or latitude gives cell 0 and validity 0
